feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 September 2026 10:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales.


##Synopsis##

Atlantic low tracks eastwards, driving associated frontal troughs across the Irish Sea during Friday.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, briefly decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 late tonight or around dawn, then gradually increasing Southwest 6 or 7 through tomorrow morning and occasionally gale 8 in the afternoon, especially in east of area. Then becoming Southwest 6 occasionally 7 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west tomorrow, turning patchy later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 6 occasionally 7, decreasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain at first.
